lines: I won't give you my blade 'till I know you won't use it against us!
Prove yourself and I'll forge you a sharp and crooked blade!
I don't forge for filth like you.
How about some armor, fresh off the forge!
I have armor fit for the strongest Uruk-hai!
With my armor on the Horse-men will run from you in fear!
My filthy swords may be crooked, but they're as sharp as Saruman's tongue!
My axes can chop down even the nastiest Tree-folk!
Many trees have fallen to the axes I forge!
My blades are forged in the blood of the Horse-men!
How about a dagger? Perfect for knifing someone!
You've got a filthy blade there, how about getting a sharper one?
I have a dirty scimitar forged fresh for you, #p.
Want a blade? I know you'll make nasty use out of it #p.
I have a knife ready to gut some Horse-boys just for you!
I'll hammer you in like a crooked blade!
I'll throw your corpse into my forge!
